required: Decode every GIF frame and its duration
Inspect the complete 12-pose native sheet at 1x and nearest-neighbor 4x
Inspect all four directions over the complete stepA-idle-stepB-idle cycle
Compare leg chains and shoe contact in stepA and stepB; changes in pixel count alone are insufficient

criticalFailures.name: Unreadable human silhouette
criticalFailures.condition: At native size the head, shoulders, torso/hip transition and two legs cannot be read as one compact human; a pole torso, detached ornament or unstructured blob dominates.

criticalFailures.name: Impossible anatomy
criticalFailures.condition: A pose contains detached/floating hands or shoes, an extra apparent limb, a broken limb attachment, or a foot whose leg cannot be traced plausibly to the hip. Deliberate occlusion in a profile is allowed.

criticalFailures.name: False walking
criticalFailures.condition: StepA and stepB fail to exchange support/swing roles plausibly; translating the whole sprite, wiggling arms, changing shoe pixels or spreading legs without genuine limb alternation is insufficient.

criticalFailures.name: Lost hero identity
criticalFailures.condition: The cap, vest and gold-red backpack do not form a consistent costume across views: front must read cap/vest, back must read a shaped gold-red pack, sides must place the same pack behind the torso rather than as a gold stripe or arbitrary belt.

criticalFailures.name: Distracting loop fault
criticalFailures.condition: The complete cycle has an unexplained head/body jump, changing limb length or costume recolor, foot popping, or a visible seam from final idle to stepA.

criticalFailures.name: Contract or evidence failure
criticalFailures.condition: The native contract fails, any frame/direction is omitted from review, or only a static first GIF frame is reviewed.

axes.criteria: Compact expressive human silhouette; intentional head/shoulder/hip balance; readable at 1x; no geometric scarecrow effect.
Clear face/profile, shoulders, arm attachment, hands, hip division and shoes; controlled chunky anatomy rather than parallel one-pixel sticks or random elbows.
Opposed arm/leg action with traceable alternating legs and believable foot contact; purposeful restrained stride and weight transfer in every direction.
Purposeful connected color clusters, selective contours, clean diagonal rhythm, restrained shading; no noisy singleton highlights, doubled outlines or stripe soup.
Coherent recognizable cap/vest/gold-red pack with volume, attachment and orientation; attractive distinguishing shape, not color labels alone.
Unambiguous direction and same character, scale, proportions and accessory placement through all turns.
All decoded frames and timing produce smooth repeating steps, stable intentional upper-body action and no contact/phase seam.

ratingAnchors.full: Cohesive finished native game sprite with no visible repair request
ratingAnchors.seventyPercent: Readable and serviceable but a specific visible craft weakness remains
ratingAnchors.half: Recognizable placeholder with substantial geometric/anatomical/motion shortcomings

changePolicy: Do not change weights, minima, critical conditions or pass threshold in response to the candidate. A failed candidate requires revised artwork. Record uncertain readings explicitly rather than award assumed points.
